chromie.Deep Breathing: Ramps Dragon's Breath into a real waveclear and AoE nuke; take when they clump so you land hits and finish the quest fast.
chromie.Andorhal Anomaly: Three Time Traps let you wall off multiple angles and guarantee Sand Blast follow-ups; the core trap-control pick.
chromie.Mobius Loop: Adds a slow to Dragon's Breath so you self-peel and land guaranteed Sand Blasts on anyone caught in the center.
chromie.Slowing Sands: A lockdown zone to trap immobile targets and guarantee your poke lands; plays directly to punishing rooted comps.
chromie.Here and There: Your repositioning escape; swap to an Echo to dodge dives and keep max range on comps that can't reach you.
chromie.Quantum Overdrive: A burst window that turns poke into a one-shot; landing Sand Blast keeps it near-permanent uptime.
chromie.Unravelling: Turns Slowing Sands into a spell-armor shred zone so your whole team's magic burst amplifies on trapped enemies.

deathwing.Draconic Might: Your only sustain since you can't be healed; attack lifesteal keeps armor plates up so you can brawl and flank.
deathwing.Heat Wave: Destroyer-form AoE that pressures clumped teams and clears waves; take when you want teamfight and lane zone.
deathwing.Skyfall: Adds ranged meteor pressure after Dragonflight; chip poke that punishes grouped enemies from safety.
deathwing.Burn Beneath My Shadow: Amps Cataclysm's DoT and resets it on structure kills; snowball a sieging lead into repeated map-wide damage.
deathwing.Wicked Inferno: Makes Molten Flame sustainable so you channel it longer; the pick when you're the Destroyer-form face-melter.
deathwing.Conflagration: Adds a burn execute to Molten Flame for real burst on the tanks and heroes you sustain the beam on.
deathwing.Stood in the Fire: Turns Cataclysm's scorched ground into a slow zone so enemies can't escape your follow-up damage.

deckard.Scroll of Identify: Ramps Scroll of Sealing into a real root-and-damage tool plus reveal; take to make your root chains reliable.
deckard.Ruby: Turns Horadric Cube into burst plus a wave of healing potions; the value pick that adds damage and sustain at once.
deckard.Cube Mastery: Cheaper seals and cube-into-seal CD refunds so you can chain your root and slow lockdowns nonstop.
deckard.Stay Awhile and Listen: Your fight-flipping AoE sleep; lock a whole clumped team and set up your side's wombo combo.
deckard.Super Healing Potion: Doubles potion healing when not instantly grabbed; your main throughput boost as the potion-based healer.
deckard.Safety in Numbers: Grants your grouped team armor and mana; the defensive spike for protecting a diving, stacked frontline.
deckard.Morenados!: Extra Lorenado charge plus CD refund on knockbacks; more displacement to peel and disrupt late-game fights.

dehaka.Enduring Swarm: Spell armor while Dark Swarm is up; the survivability to dive in and sustain through their magic burst.
dehaka.Hero Stalker: Doubles essence from takedowns and swarm hits so you reach max Health faster; the standard growth pick.
dehaka.Feeding Frenzy: Attacks refund Drag's cooldown and extend it; keeps your isolate-and-drag lockdown online every fight.
dehaka.Isolation: The reason you draft Dehaka to pick a carry: silence, slow and reveal to yank one target from their team.
dehaka.Ferocious Stalker: Amps Dark Swarm damage and adds a slow while roam speed is up; your ganking and brawl damage spike.
dehaka.Elongated Tongue: More Drag range so you hook from further and isolate deeper into their backline.
dehaka.Contagion: Isolation now hits everyone near the target; turns a single pick into a team-wide silence wombo.

diablo.Devil's Due: Souls boost globe and fountain healing; the soak-and-sustain pick to stay healthy while stacking your bulk.
diablo.Souls to the Flame: Fire Stomp generates souls and heals; your in-combat soul engine that fuels the Health-per-soul trait.
diablo.Diabolical Momentum: Attacks slash Shadow Charge and Overpower cooldowns; lets you chain your CC combos far more often.
diablo.Lightning Breath: Unstoppable channel for reliable zone damage; take over Apocalypse when you want anti-dive and self-peel.
diablo.Cruelty: Stunning with Charge or Overpower ramps your attack speed; converts your combo into real follow-up auto damage.
diablo.Overpowering Nightmare: Two extra Overpower charges; more displacement and stuns to flip multiple targets into your team.
diablo.Dying Breath: Huge Apocalypse CD refund per hero hit plus a free death-cast; gives you near-constant lockdown ult uptime.

dva.Full Metal: More mech Health plus fusion-cannon lifesteal; the frontline sustain to body-block on the point longer.
dva.Rush-down: Boosters deal percent-Health damage and heal you; turns your engage into real burst and sustain vs tanks.
dva.Get On The Point!: Boosters grant team speed and refresh faster when undamaged; keeps you mobile for repeated zoning and peels.
dva.Micro Missiles: Burst damage that combos off Boosters; the kill-pressure pick over the purely defensive Bunny Hop.
dva.Target Locked: Defense Matrix shreds armor and slows; converts your skillshot-denial zone into a damage-amp for your team.
dva.In For The Kill: Boosters grant a shield and ramp attack damage per hero hit; your bruiser spike for diving their clump.
dva.Stop and Pop: Extends Bunny Hop and stops decay while stationary; turns the ult into a long AoE zone-lock on the point.

etc.Prog Rock: Ramps Guitar Solo healing into real teamfight sustain; the standard scaling pick to stay healthy in fights.
etc.Crowd Surfer: Powerslide over walls with a CD refund on a miss; your flexible engage or escape angle and free re-engages.
etc.Pinball Wizard: Face Melt smashes anyone recently Powerslid; your burst combo to punish targets you just knocked.
etc.Mosh Pit: Your wombo and the whole reason to draft ETC: a 4-second AoE stun that sets up every follow-up on your team.
etc.Encore: Face Melt leaves a second knockback and refunds CD per hero hit; more disruption and faster ability uptime.
etc.Show Stopper: 35 armor after Powerslide; take when you dive so you survive the focus right after engaging.
etc.Tour Bus: Mosh refreshes Powerslide and can extend Mosh; engage, stun, then reposition or lengthen the wombo.

falstad.Gathering Storm: Ramps Hammerang into heavy poke and waveclear; the scaling pick that rewards landing your skillshot.
falstad.Static Shield: Lightning Rod grants a stacking shield; free survivability while you sit and auto-attack in fights.
falstad.Secret Weapon: Longer Hammerang plus big attack bonus while it's out; your core auto-attack DPS spike.
falstad.Hinterland Blast: Long-range execute nuke with a huge CD refund on hits; snipe low targets and poke from total safety.
falstad.Flow Rider: Tailwind doubles ability recharge; nonstop Hammerang and Barrel Roll uptime while you rotate the map.
falstad.Aerie Gusts: Faster, stronger Tailwind; more sustained move speed to auto-kite and rotate between lanes quicker.
falstad.Call of the Wildhammer: Double-range, higher-damage Hinterland Blast; a map-wide execute that finishes fights from screens away.

fenix.Mobile Offense: Bonus attack damage after moving; rewards your kiting so you keep poking between repositions.
fenix.Target Acquired: Attacks on slowed heroes stack move speed; keeps you glued to kited targets and safe while dealing damage.
fenix.Combat Advantage: Plasma Cutter hits slowed targets harder; your burst combo right after you land the slow.
fenix.Planet Cracker: A battleground-wide beam for massive sustained teamfight and wave damage; the standard high-output heroic.
fenix.Auxiliary Shields: Trades Health for a huge shield that regens off attacks; the survivability engine to brawl at the front.
fenix.Offensive Cadence: Every 3rd attack deals percent-max Health; the reason Fenix melts tanks, scales your DPS vs beefy targets.
fenix.Singularity Charge: Doubles Repeater Cannon attack speed; your late-game DPS explosion that shreds anything you focus.

gall.Keep Moving!: Better Shove speed and duration off Cho's movement; helps the shared body reposition and kite in fights.
gall.Rising Dread: Dread Orb ramps radius and damage and can reverse; your main poke, controllable AoE that punishes clumps.
gall.Edge of Madness: Stacking Shadowflame damage on the same target; rewards sustained focus for real single-target burst.
gall.Shadow Bolt Volley: Aim-controlled barrage for enormous teamfight damage; the standard high-output heroic.
gall.Searing Shadows: Shadowflame adds percent-max Health damage; scales your poke against high-Health frontlines.
gall.Shadowsnare: Basic abilities stack a slow; self-peel and lockdown to hold enemies in your damage since Cho drives movement.
gall.The Will of Gall: Takedowns permanently ramp Ogre Rage; snowballs your damage the longer the game and the more kills you get.

garrosh.Warbreaker: Quest adds a big DoT to Groundbreaker's stun; take for kill pressure and to reward landing your primary CC.
garrosh.In For the Kill: Bloodthirst resets and refunds on kills plus sustain; your lane-sustain and self-heal engine to stay topped.
garrosh.Intimidation: Groundbreaker slows enemy attack speed; the anti-auto-attacker pick to blunt their carry's DPS.
garrosh.Warlord's Challenge: An AoE taunt that flips a dive: silence and force their whole clump to attack you instead.
garrosh.Defensive Measures: A shield when Groundbreaker stuns; keeps you alive after committing your engage CC into their team.
garrosh.Mortal Combo: Chaining stun into Wrecking Ball slashes its CD; lets you throw enemies far more often, your signature play.
garrosh.Titanic Might: Wrecking Ball throws two enemies; double the displacement to yank multiple divers into your team.

gazlowe.Big Game Hunter: More Scrap and faster regen off attacks; fuels your ability rotation and your camp and waveclear tempo.
gazlowe.Rock It Sock It: Turret casts shield you; free survivability so you can hold your zone under pressure.
gazlowe.Goblin Fusion: Deth Lazor refunds 3 Scrap per hero hit; landing your poke supercharges your ability uptime.
gazlowe.Grav-O-Bomb 3000: An AoE pull that clumps enemies and amps your follow-up; the wombo-setup heroic for your team's burst.
gazlowe.Superior Schematics: Turrets hit extra targets at longer range; stronger zone control plus camp and waveclear.
gazlowe.Firin' Mah Lazorz: All your turrets fire a Deth Lazor with you; massive burst once you've set up a turret field.
gazlowe.Mecha-Lord: Stacking armor and bonus damage to CC'd enemies; your late-game bruiser survivability and wombo payoff.

genji.Swift as the Wind: Swift Strike grants move speed on hero hits; keeps you slippery to weave in and out of their backline.
genji.Shuriken Mastery: Quest ramps Shuriken damage and cuts Cyber Agility CD; your core scaling for both burst and mobility.
genji.Augmented Guard: Deflect converts blocked damage into a shield; rewards a good deflect with the survivability to dive again.
genji.X-Strike: A delayed cross burst that combos with Swift Strike resets; the high-burst pick to delete a squishy.
genji.Shingan: Hitting all 3 Shuriken adds big bonus damage; your primary damage spike for landing full combos.
genji.Steady Blade: Swift Strike stacks damage per hero hit; rewards diving into their clump with escalating burst.
genji.The Dragon Becomes Me: Dragonblade extends on hits and refreshes Swift Strike on kills; turns a fed ult into a backline massacre.

greymane.Wolfheart: Bigger Inner Beast CD reduction per attack; keeps your Worgen burst windows up far more often.
greymane.Insatiable: Attacks restore mana and cut Healing Fountain CD; solves your mana and adds map sustain for aggressive play.
greymane.Quicksilver Bullets: Longer Human attack range; lets you poke and Cocktail safely before committing to a Worgen dive.
greymane.Go for the Throat: A leap execute that can chain on kills; the pick to dive and reset through their backline.
greymane.Running Wild: Longer, lower-CD Darkflight and Disengage; more dive range in and safety out, your mobility spike.
greymane.Alpha Killer: Worgen attacks add percent-max Health damage; the reason you shred tanks, scales your sustained DPS.
greymane.Unleashed: Go for the Throat hits harder and fully resets on kills; snowball a teamfight into a solo wipe.

guldan.Pursuit of Flame: Widens Fel Flame; the standard scaling pick since Fel Flame is your bread-and-butter poke and sustain fuel.
guldan.Improved Life Tap: More mana per Life Tap; keeps your no-cooldown spam online so you never run dry mid-fight.
guldan.Curse of Exhaustion: Drain Life adds damage and a heavy slow; self-peel plus a lockdown to hold targets in your damage.
guldan.Horrify: Your fight-flipper: an AoE fear and silence that breaks their engage and sets up your team's follow-up.
guldan.Fel Armor: Spell armor on Fel Flame hits; the survivability vs burst mages so you can stand and channel damage.
guldan.Darkness Within: A free Life Tap plus a spell-power burst after damage; your damage spike that rewards landing spells.
guldan.Haunt: Longer Horrify plus armor shred on feared enemies; turns your CC ult into a team-wide damage-amp wombo.
